title: 5.16 Un sábado de compras
unit_outcome: Say how much and how many, offer and order food and drinks politely, agree about likes, say what you want and need to do, talk about meals, prices and what is in your food, compare prices, use numbers to ninety-nine and ask for things at the table.
goal: Spend Saturday with Ana and Luis at the market, a shop and a café: find shoppers by how much fruit they have, things by their price, the cheaper and the more expensive bag and watch, what café customers want, the things on the lunch table and what is in each dish, and answer aloud for Ana: agree, refuse an offer, finish shopping and say a price.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 5.16 Un día en el mercado y el café: A1 closes Unit 5 with market purchases and a café order; A1+ 5.16 closes A1+ Unit 5 with Ana and Luis's Saturday at the market, a shop and a café, with no new language. The learner finds shoppers by a lot of / a few (5.1), things by their price (5.12), the cheaper and the more expensive bag and watch (5.11), what café customers want to do (5.6), the fork, the knife, the spoon and the butter on the table (5.14, 5.2) and what is in each dish (5.13), then answers aloud for Ana with So do I. (5.5), No, thank you. to an offer (5.3), That's all (5.10) and They're three dollars. (5.8). Every mission photo is new and used only here.
speaking_outcome: Answer four times aloud for Ana: agree with Luis, refuse his offer politely, finish shopping and tell Diego the price of the apples.
